landing.headline: Drop your bottle. Scan the bin. Earn credit.
landing.subhead: Log the plastic you recycle on campus. Points are added after each bin is weighed and verified, and certificates follow as your contribution grows.
landing.step_1_desc: Drop clean, empty plastic into a marked bin.
landing.step_2_desc: Scan the QR on the bin and sign in once.
landing.step_3_desc: Enter how many items you dropped. Points arrive after verification.

actions.sign_in: Sign in to log your drop

faq.a: We verify every bin by weighing it, so points are added after that check (daily or weekly).

faq.q: What can I put in the bin?
faq.a: [CLIENT TO CONFIRM: accepted items and rules, for example clean and empty, caps on or off, labels].
You can cancel an entry within 5 minutes while it is still pending. After that, contact sustainability@campusplasticcredits.org.

faq.q: How many items can I log?
faq.a: Up to 20 per entry and 40 per day. Limits keep counts fair.
When your points reach a tier, we issue a PDF certificate with a unique ID that anyone can verify online.
Only you and the programme admins. Public certificate checks show your first name and last initial only. See the privacy notice.
